topic: SAP amount parsing must validate format before stripping commas
lesson: In sap-actuals.parser.ts, validate the monetary string's FORMAT before removing commas - a bare comma-strip accepts malformed inputs like '1,00' or '1,2,3' as 100.00/123.00. Require a strict decimal shape (optional sign, digits with well-formed thousands grouping, optional .dd) and reject anything else with a row/column diagnostic; for numeric Excel cells read the numeric value directly (do not validate via String(value), which shows float drift).
